media_prompt: Technical illustration / visual diagram illustrating: Winning second prize in the AWS Builders Club hackathon

humanizer_audit.full_audit_report:
48 hours. One teammate. Second place at the AWS Builders Club hackathon.  
We teamed up with a colleague—had a vague idea and a ticking clock, and every minute counted.  
Learning AWS services on the fly while syncing our vision was tougher than we expected.  
Pressure mounted as the clock ticked down.  
At the final hour we delivered a working prototype.  
We walked away with second prize and hands‑on AWS experience.  
48‑hour sprint • Second place in the AWS Builders Club hackathon • Team of two  
What’s the toughest deadline you’ve ever met, and what did it teach you?
